city.en: The city added more bicycle lanes to reduce traffic congestion.
city.zh: 這座城市增設更多自行車道，以減少交通壅塞。

civil.en: The discussion remained civil even when the students strongly disagreed.
civil.zh: 即使學生意見分歧很大，討論仍保持理性有禮。

civilian.en: The museum tells stories about civilian life during the war.
civilian.zh: 博物館介紹戰爭期間平民生活的故事。

claim.en: The article makes a claim that is supported by several studies.
claim.zh: 這篇文章提出一項由多項研究支持的主張。

class.en: Our class will visit the science museum next Friday.
class.zh: 我們班下星期五要參觀科學博物館。

classic.en: The library displayed a classic novel that has remained popular for decades.
classic.zh: 圖書館展示了一本數十年來仍受歡迎的經典小說。

classical.en: She listens to classical music while doing quiet homework.
classical.zh: 她做需要安靜完成的作業時會聽古典音樂。

classify.en: Students learned to classify animals according to shared characteristics.
classify.zh: 學生學會依共同特徵將動物分類。

classmate.en: My classmate helped me understand the final math problem.
classmate.zh: 我的同學幫我理解最後一道數學題。

classroom.en: The classroom became quiet as soon as the test began.
classroom.zh: 考試一開始，教室立刻安靜下來。

clean.en: Please clean the equipment carefully after finishing the experiment.
clean.zh: 實驗完成後請仔細清潔器材。

clear.en: A clear explanation makes a difficult idea easier to understand.
clear.zh: 清楚的解釋能讓困難的觀念更容易理解。

clearly.en: Please speak clearly so everyone in the room can hear you.
clearly.zh: 請清楚說話，讓房間裡每個人都聽得到。

clerk.en: The store clerk helped us find the correct size.
clerk.zh: 店員幫我們找到正確的尺寸。

clever.en: She found a clever way to solve the problem with fewer steps.
clever.zh: 她找到一個用更少步驟解決問題的聰明方法。

click.en: Click the save button before closing the document.
click.zh: 關閉文件前請點擊儲存按鈕。

client.en: The designer met with the client to discuss the new website.
client.zh: 設計師與客戶見面討論新網站。

climate.en: Scientists study climate patterns to understand long-term environmental change.
climate.zh: 科學家研究氣候模式，以了解長期環境變化。

climb.en: We began to climb the hill before sunrise.
climb.zh: 我們在日出前開始爬上山坡。

clock.en: The clock on the wall was five minutes slow.
clock.zh: 牆上的時鐘慢了五分鐘。

close.en: Please close the window before leaving the classroom.
close.zh: 離開教室前請把窗戶關上。

closely.en: The researchers closely examined the results before publishing them.
closely.zh: 研究人員在發表結果前仔細檢視資料。

cloth.en: Use a soft cloth to clean the computer screen.
cloth.zh: 請用柔軟的布清潔電腦螢幕。

clothes.en: She packed warm clothes because the mountain weather was cold.
clothes.zh: 因為山區天氣寒冷，她帶了保暖衣物。

cloud.en: A dark cloud appeared above the mountains before the storm.
cloud.zh: 暴風雨前，一大片烏雲出現在山上。

club.en: The science club meets every Wednesday after school.
club.zh: 科學社每星期三放學後聚會。

coach.en: The coach encouraged the players to communicate during the game.
coach.zh: 教練鼓勵球員在比賽中互相溝通。

coal.en: Burning coal produces energy but also releases carbon dioxide.
coal.zh: 燃燒煤可以產生能源，但也會排放二氧化碳。

coast.en: The storm moved slowly along the eastern coast overnight.
coast.zh: 暴風雨整夜沿著東部海岸緩慢移動。

coat.en: He wore a thick coat because the morning was unusually cold.
coat.zh: 因為早晨異常寒冷，他穿了一件厚外套。

code.en: Students wrote simple code to control the small robot.
code.zh: 學生寫了簡單程式碼來控制小型機器人。

coffee.en: She bought a cup of coffee before the morning meeting.
coffee.zh: 早會前她買了一杯咖啡。

coin.en: The old coin was displayed behind glass in the museum.
coin.zh: 這枚古老硬幣被陳列在博物館的玻璃櫃後。

cold.en: The water felt extremely cold after the temperature dropped overnight.
cold.zh: 夜間降溫後，水摸起來非常冰冷。

collapse.en: The weak structure could collapse if too much weight was added.
collapse.zh: 如果加上過多重量，這個脆弱結構可能會倒塌。

collect.en: Students collect data every week for their science project.
collect.zh: 學生每週為科學專題蒐集資料。

collection.en: The museum has a large collection of traditional tools.
collection.zh: 這座博物館收藏了大量傳統工具。

college.en: She plans to study engineering when she enters college.
college.zh: 她計畫上大學後念工程。

color.en: The leaves change color when the weather becomes cooler.
color.zh: 天氣變涼時，樹葉會變色。

column.en: Write each answer in the correct column of the table.
column.zh: 請把每個答案寫在表格正確的欄位中。

combine.en: We can combine the two ideas into one stronger proposal.
combine.zh: 我們可以把兩個想法結合成一個更完整的提案。

come.en: Many useful ideas come from asking simple questions.
come.zh: 許多實用想法都來自提出簡單問題。

comfort.en: A quiet room can provide comfort after a stressful day.
comfort.zh: 忙碌有壓力的一天後，安靜的房間能帶來舒適感。

comfortable.en: These chairs are comfortable enough for long study sessions.
comfortable.zh: 這些椅子很舒適，適合長時間讀書。

command.en: The computer will follow each command in the order given.
command.zh: 電腦會依照輸入順序執行每一道指令。

comment.en: The teacher wrote a helpful comment beside my final paragraph.
comment.zh: 老師在我最後一段旁寫了一則有幫助的評語。

commerce.en: Online commerce has changed how people buy everyday products.
commerce.zh: 線上商業改變了人們購買日常用品的方式。

commercial.en: The commercial used humor to make the product memorable.
commercial.zh: 這則廣告用幽默讓產品更令人印象深刻。

commit.en: Students should commit enough time to preparing for major exams.
commit.zh: 學生應投入足夠時間準備重要考試。

committee.en: The committee will review the proposal at tomorrow's meeting.
committee.zh: 委員會會在明天的會議審查這項提案。

common.en: Stress is a common problem among students during exam season.
common.zh: 考試期間，壓力是學生常見的問題。

commonly.en: This expression is commonly used in everyday conversation.
commonly.zh: 這個表達方式常用於日常對話。

communicate.en: Group members should communicate clearly when dividing their tasks.
communicate.zh: 小組成員分配工作時應清楚溝通。

communication.en: Good communication can prevent many problems in group projects.
communication.zh: 良好溝通能避免小組專題中的許多問題。

community.en: The community organized a weekend cleanup around the local park.
community.zh: 社區在週末舉辦了當地公園清潔活動。

company.en: The company plans to reduce its energy use next year.
company.zh: 這家公司計畫明年降低能源使用量。

compare.en: Please compare the two graphs before answering the question.
compare.zh: 回答問題前請比較這兩張圖表。

comparison.en: The report includes a comparison of three different learning methods.
comparison.zh: 這份報告比較了三種不同的學習方法。

compete.en: Several schools will compete in the regional science contest.
compete.zh: 數所學校將參加地區科學競賽。

competition.en: The competition attracted students from across the country.
competition.zh: 這項比賽吸引了全國各地的學生。

competitive.en: The scholarship program is highly competitive this year.
competitive.zh: 今年這項獎學金計畫競爭非常激烈。

complain.en: Some residents complain about the noise from late-night traffic.
complain.zh: 一些居民抱怨深夜交通造成的噪音。

complete.en: Please complete the survey before the end of class.
complete.zh: 請在下課前完成這份問卷。

completely.en: The old building was completely renovated during the summer.
completely.zh: 這棟老建築在暑假期間徹底整修。

complex.en: The teacher used a diagram to explain the complex process.
complex.zh: 老師用圖示來解釋這個複雜過程。

complicate.en: Too many extra rules can complicate a simple procedure.
complicate.zh: 太多額外規定可能讓簡單程序變得複雜。

complicated.en: The instructions looked complicated until the teacher demonstrated each step.
complicated.zh: 在老師逐步示範前，這些說明看起來很複雜。

component.en: Each component must be tested before the machine is assembled.
component.zh: 機器組裝前，每個零件都必須先測試。

compose.en: Students were asked to compose a short paragraph using the new words.
compose.zh: 學生被要求用新單字寫一小段文章。

composition.en: Her composition had a clear introduction and a strong conclusion.
composition.zh: 她的作文有清楚的開頭和有力的結尾。

computer.en: The school replaced several old computer units in the library.
computer.zh: 學校更換了圖書館裡幾台老舊電腦。

concentrate.en: It is easier to concentrate when your phone is turned off.
concentrate.zh: 手機關機時比較容易專心。

concentration.en: Noise can reduce concentration during difficult reading tasks.
concentration.zh: 噪音會降低進行困難閱讀時的專注力。

concept.en: The teacher explained the concept with a simple everyday example.
concept.zh: 老師用簡單的日常例子解釋這個概念。

concern.en: Air pollution is a major concern in many large cities.
concern.zh: 空氣污染是許多大城市的重要問題。

concerned.en: Parents were concerned about the safety of the old playground.
concerned.zh: 家長對老舊遊樂場的安全感到擔心。

concert.en: The school concert will take place in the main hall tonight.
concert.zh: 學校音樂會今晚會在大禮堂舉行。

conclude.en: We cannot conclude anything until all the results are checked.
conclude.zh: 在所有結果都檢查完成前，我們不能下結論。

conclusion.en: The conclusion summarizes the main findings of the report.
conclusion.zh: 結論總結了報告的主要發現。

concrete.en: Please give a concrete example to support your argument.
concrete.zh: 請舉一個具體例子支持你的論點。

condition.en: The equipment must be kept in good condition for safety.
condition.zh: 為了安全，設備必須保持良好狀態。

conduct.en: The students will conduct a survey about reading habits.
conduct.zh: 學生將進行一項關於閱讀習慣的調查。

conference.en: The teacher attended an education conference during the weekend.
conference.zh: 老師週末參加了一場教育研討會。

confidence.en: Regular speaking practice can build confidence over time.
confidence.zh: 規律口說練習能逐漸建立自信。

confident.en: She felt confident after practicing her presentation several times.
confident.zh: 練習報告好幾次後，她感到很有自信。

confirm.en: Please confirm the meeting time before making travel arrangements.
confirm.zh: 安排交通前請先確認會議時間。

conflict.en: Clear communication can prevent a small disagreement from becoming conflict.
conflict.zh: 清楚溝通能避免小歧見演變成衝突。

confuse.en: Similar spelling can confuse students who are learning new vocabulary.
confuse.zh: 相似的拼字可能讓正在學新單字的學生混淆。

confused.en: I felt confused until the teacher explained the final step.
confused.zh: 直到老師解釋最後一步，我才不再感到困惑。

connect.en: This bridge will connect the two sides of the river.
connect.zh: 這座橋將連接河流兩岸。

connection.en: The study found a connection between sleep and memory performance.
connection.zh: 這項研究發現睡眠與記憶表現之間有關聯。

consequence.en: One consequence of poor planning is unnecessary stress.
consequence.zh: 規劃不佳的一個後果是不必要的壓力。

consider.en: Please consider all the evidence before making your decision.
consider.zh: 做決定前請考慮所有證據。

considerable.en: The project required a considerable amount of time and effort.
considerable.zh: 這項專題需要相當多的時間與努力。

consist.en: The final exam will consist of four different sections.
consist.zh: 期末考將由四個不同部分組成。

constant.en: Constant practice is more effective than studying only before tests.
constant.zh: 持續練習比只在考前讀書更有效。

construct.en: Students used wooden sticks to construct a small bridge model.
construct.zh: 學生用木棒搭建一座小型橋梁模型。

construction.en: Road construction caused heavy traffic near the school this morning.
construction.zh: 道路施工造成今天早上學校附近交通壅塞。

contact.en: Please contact the office if your schedule changes.
contact.zh: 如果你的行程有變，請聯絡辦公室。

contain.en: This box may contain materials needed for the experiment.
contain.zh: 這個箱子可能裝有實驗所需材料。

container.en: Store the liquid in a clean container with a tight lid.
container.zh: 請把液體存放在有密封蓋的乾淨容器裡。

content.en: The teacher reviewed the content before giving the final quiz.
content.zh: 老師在期末小考前複習了課程內容。

contest.en: Our team entered a writing contest organized by the library.
contest.zh: 我們的隊伍參加了圖書館舉辦的寫作比賽。

context.en: The context can help you guess the meaning of an unfamiliar word.
context.zh: 語境能幫助你猜出陌生單字的意思。

continue.en: We will continue the discussion after everyone finishes reading.
continue.zh: 等大家讀完後，我們會繼續討論。

contract.en: The company signed a contract with a local supplier.
contract.zh: 這家公司與當地供應商簽了一份合約。

contrast.en: The essay shows a clear contrast between the two characters.
contrast.zh: 這篇文章清楚呈現兩個角色之間的對比。

contribute.en: Every student should contribute at least one idea to the project.
contribute.zh: 每位學生都應至少為專題提供一個想法。

control.en: The experiment shows how temperature can control the speed of a reaction.
control.zh: 這個實驗顯示溫度如何控制反應速度。

convenient.en: Online registration is convenient for students who live far away.
convenient.zh: 線上報名對住得遠的學生很方便。

conversation.en: A short conversation can reveal how differently people view the same issue.
conversation.zh: 短短一段對話就能看出人們對同一議題的不同看法。

cook.en: We learned to cook a simple meal during the class activity.
cook.zh: 我們在課堂活動中學會煮一道簡單餐點。

cool.en: Keep the medicine in a cool place away from sunlight.
cool.zh: 請把藥品放在陰涼且避免陽光直射的地方。

cooperate.en: Students must cooperate if they want the group project to succeed.
cooperate.zh: 學生若想讓小組專題成功，就必須合作。

cooperation.en: The event succeeded because of strong cooperation among all the volunteers.
cooperation.zh: 這場活動因所有志工通力合作而成功。

copy.en: Please copy the sentence carefully into your notebook.
copy.zh: 請把這個句子仔細抄到筆記本上。

corner.en: The bookstore is located on the corner across from the station.
corner.zh: 書店位於車站對面的街角。

correct.en: Please check whether your final answer is correct.
correct.zh: 請檢查你的最後答案是否正確。

correctly.en: Students must use the equipment correctly to avoid accidents.
correctly.zh: 學生必須正確使用設備，以避免意外。

cost.en: The total cost was lower than we had expected.
cost.zh: 總成本比我們原先預期的低。

cotton.en: This shirt is made from soft cotton that feels comfortable.
cotton.zh: 這件襯衫由柔軟棉布製成，穿起來很舒服。

could.en: A small mistake could change the final result of the calculation.
could.zh: 一個小錯誤可能改變計算的最後結果。

council.en: The student council organized a meeting about campus safety.
council.zh: 學生會舉辦了一場關於校園安全的會議。

count.en: Please count the number of responses before entering the data.
count.zh: 輸入資料前請先數回覆的數量。

country.en: Each country faces different challenges in protecting the environment.
country.zh: 每個國家在環境保護方面面臨不同挑戰。

couple.en: We waited a couple of minutes for the bus to arrive.
couple.zh: 我們等了幾分鐘讓公車到站。

courage.en: It takes courage to admit a mistake in front of others.
courage.zh: 在別人面前承認錯誤需要勇氣。

course.en: This course teaches students how to analyze scientific data.
course.zh: 這門課教學生如何分析科學資料。

court.en: The school has a basketball court behind the gym.
court.zh: 學校體育館後方有一座籃球場。

cover.en: The final test will cover all the chapters we studied.
cover.zh: 期末考會涵蓋我們讀過的所有章節。

create.en: Students used recycled materials to create useful classroom objects.
create.zh: 學生用回收材料製作實用的教室物品。

creative.en: The project encourages students to develop creative solutions to real problems.
creative.zh: 這項專題鼓勵學生為真實問題發展有創意的解決方案。

credit.en: The report gives credit to everyone who contributed to the research.
credit.zh: 這份報告對所有參與研究的人給予應有肯定。

crime.en: The article examines how technology is used to prevent crime.
crime.zh: 這篇文章探討科技如何被用來預防犯罪。

crisis.en: Clear communication is especially important during a crisis.
crisis.zh: 在危機期間，清楚溝通尤其重要。

criticize.en: It is easier to criticize a plan than to suggest a better one.
criticize.zh: 批評一個計畫比提出更好的方案容易。

crop.en: The farmers changed the crop after several seasons of poor rainfall.
crop.zh: 連續幾季降雨不足後，農民更換了作物。

cross.en: Use the bridge to cross the river safely.

crowd.en: A large crowd gathered outside the stadium before the game.
crowd.zh: 比賽前，一大群人聚集在體育場外。

crucial.en: Good planning is crucial when a project has a short deadline.
crucial.zh: 專題期限很短時，良好規劃非常重要。

culture.en: Food is an important part of every culture.
culture.zh: 飲食是每種文化的重要一部分。

cup.en: She filled a cup with warm water before class.
cup.zh: 上課前，她倒了一杯溫水。

current.en: The report describes the current situation and suggests possible improvements.
current.zh: 這份報告描述目前情況並提出可能的改善方式。

customer.en: The store asked each customer to complete a short survey.
customer.zh: 商店請每位顧客填寫一份簡短問卷。

cut.en: Use scissors to cut the paper along the dotted line.
cut.zh: 請用剪刀沿著虛線剪紙。

cycle.en: The diagram shows the complete water cycle from evaporation to rainfall.
cycle.zh: 這張圖示顯示從蒸發到降雨的完整水循環。
